summary.text: At a glance: DNB BANK ASA is a public limited company (ASA) in Oslo, working in banker og kredittforetak; 7,347 registered employees; website https://www.dnb.no.

What's new (past 12 months, newest first): 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 7347; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 7353; 2026-08-12 employee count updated: 7488; 2026-07-15 employee count updated: 7569; 2026-06-17 share capital changed; 2026-06-13 employee count updated: 7536; +10 more.
DNB BANK ASA (org. no. 984851006): Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2002-09-10.

What it does: Primary industry: 64.190 Banker og kredittforetak. Registered purpose: Å drive bank-, finansierings- og investeringstjenestevirksomhet, samt virksomhet som har en naturlig tilknytning til dette, og å inneha eierinteresser eller være deltaker i andre foretak innenfor rammen av den til enhver tid gjeldende lovgivning.
Business address: Dronning Eufemias gate 30, 0191 OSLO, Norge (OSLO municipality).
People: CEO (daglig leder): Kjerstin Elisabeth Rasmussen Braathen; board chair: Eimund Nygaard; 9 other board members; auditor: ERNST & YOUNG AS.
Locations: 59 active sub-units registered (incl. ALTA, ARENDAL, ASKER, ASKIM, TRONDHEIM).
Status: no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced-dissolution flags registered.
Identity: share capital NOK 18,008,310,800 (registered 2026-06-17); formerly registered as DNB NOR BANK ASA (until 2011-11-11), GJENSIDIGE NOR SPAREBANK ASA (until 2004-01-19).
Website: https://www.dnb.no (as registered, and verified on the site).
Hiring: no active job ads on arbeidsplassen.no (NAV) for this company or its sub-units.
Recent registry activity: 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 7347; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 7353; 2026-08-12 employee count updated: 7488 (17 events since 2025).
Changes: none since the previous check on 2026-11-06.
Unknown or not published: annual accounts (source unavailable this run), company profiles (none linked from its website), job postings (none active on NAV).
